sentences.japanese: 空に美しい虹がかかっている。
sentences.english: A beautiful rainbow is spanning the sky.

sentences.japanese: 雨が止んだとたんにきれいな虹が出た。
sentences.english: No sooner had it stopped raining than a beautiful rainbow appeared.

sentences.japanese: 雨がやんだとたんに虹が現れた。
sentences.english: Scarcely had the rain stopped before a rainbow appeared.

sentences.japanese: 同じ虹を、これだけたくさんの人が撮影したものを見たことがありません。
sentences.english: I've never seen as many people as this photograph the same rainbow.
